title: Report interface version2 assigns units
body: Owner now assigns schema_version 2 and unit pieces per item in exact interface-v2. The native worker is observed interrupted. Rebind/resume will occur through the canonical material-input gate; preserve v1 and use v2 only after that gate.
requested_response: After exact assignment.inputs/followup, acknowledge current v2 notice and incorporate explicit pieces field; stop after current v2 handoff.
limitations: A notice alone cannot renew native write authority.
